title: WORLD OF CORPORATIONS
subtitle: GLOBAL MARKET SIMULATOR
description: Build a business empire in a living global market. Acquire companies, manage your portfolio, invest in research, compete with rivals and shape the future of entire industries. Every run creates a different economic story.
footer: A fictional business simulation · Your decisions shape the market

about.title: About World of Corporations
paragraphs: World of Corporations is a single-player business and market simulation. Start with limited capital, acquire companies and grow your influence across a changing global economy.
The simulation includes company valuations, industries, technologies, products, rivals, macroeconomic events and long-term market trends. All in-game outcomes are fictional.
Company names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. World of Corporations is not affiliated with or endorsed by the companies shown.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
items: Choose your player name, starting capital and difficulty.
Use Next Day or Auto to advance the simulation. Change speed whenever you want.
Acquire companies, monitor your portfolio and diversify across industries.
Use company management, research, products and strategic actions to build long-term value.
Your objective is to own the three largest companies in the market at the same time.
